items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: Mellon Boyd was a hot spot for all their paintings.

ctx.x: Well, that was worth it to them, I guess, too. It worked out fine.

It worked out fine for everybody. It worked out fine for the people giving the picnic. They'd pay for everything. And what they got took in, these dollars they took in, was all great. They had card paid for the paying and the eats. And whatever they took in in the admissions was great. And they had them, oh man, they had three or four of them on a Sunday. Mellon Boyd was a hot spot for all their paintings.
